case: MySQL app temporal parser-to-keyed-grid edit with native value and sibling-row oracles
contract: The app parser maps TIME(6) input to Value::Time and DATETIME(6)/TIMESTAMP(6) input to Value::DateTime.
The test creates a TIME(6), DATETIME(6), TIMESTAMP(6) table and sets the dedicated MySQL session timezone to +00:00.
Parser output flows through the shared keyed-update builder and executes on the MySQL connection.
Native reads assert each edited value, CAST(value AS CHAR), MICROSECOND(value), and TIMESTAMP epoch microseconds.
A second row retains its original values, verifying keyed identity and sibling preservation.

focused_docker.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app value_contract_mysql_temporal_parser_keyed_edit_preserves_native_values_and_siblings -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

parser_and_docker_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app mysql_temporal_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Installed GTK editing and other MySQL format consumers remain open.
MySQL TIMESTAMP is interpreted in the explicit UTC session; other session-timezone/edit expectations remain open.
This bounded contract does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
